[RARC.5.7.1] RHS actions other than `emit` and `withdraw`, which change
working memory directly, go through the dispatcher:

| Action | Destination |
|---|---|
| `call` | integrator's `call` callback (the integrator routes to an adapter, in-process target, or remote service of their choosing) |
| `publish` | integrator's stream callback receives an `action_publish` event; the integrator forwards it upward however it bridged the tiers |
| `cache` / `cache_delete` (actions) | integrator's cache callbacks (cache plane) |
| `log` | integrator's log callback |

A `cached(...)` read is not dispatched. It is a pure internal read of the
engine's cache and invokes no callback ([LFST.5.1]).
